conversation.message: What technical skills are you most proficient in?
React, React Native, JavaScript, Firebase, Next.js, CSS, Expo.
Can you briefly describe your last work experience?
Worked as a Frontend Developer at upwork, building mobile and web apps using React Native, React, and Firebase.
Where do you see your career heading in the next 5 years?
Becoming a senior frontend engineer, leading projects, and mentoring junior developers.
How would you describe your teamwork style?
Collaborative, communicative, and focused on achieving team goals efficiently.
